name: POPOPX Mac Node bridge
description: Ten POPOPX Mac Node services as host tools over the node's own loopback console. Report-only by default: the phantom_sentinel lockdown path is refused before any socket opens.

contract.authority: Sources/ is the producer; this manifest is generated from the kernel routing table

runtime.note: The only WebSocket in this system is the chat daemon's control socket at 127.0.0.1:5225, which the node dials and which is unauthenticated by design; a plugin must never connect there. This plugin uses HTTP request/response plus SSE and nothing else.

console.diagnosticsNote: POST /api/command is read-only in practice: the node refuses engine calls injected from the local console at its whitelist gate, so it is used for parse verdicts only.

credentials.name: consoleToken
acceptedAs: the tokenised console URL the node prints at launch
credentials.lifetime: Generated per node launch and deliberately never persisted, so a node restart invalidates this value and every plugin configuration that holds it.
neverWrittenTo: a rendered launchd or systemd unit

credentials.name: pluginSharedSecret
credentials.neededFor: Only the phantom_sentinel lockdown opt-in below. No other call uses it.

deniedTools.name: phantom_sentinel.lockdown
effect: diskutil unmount / diskutil unmountDisk (boot volume refused, never --force)
deniedTools.why: The node acts physically with no confirmation, no cooldown, no dry-run and no undo, and invoke() reaches the lock trigger before it checks whether the engine is switched off and never consults authenticated. A plugin has to refuse that line before any socket opens.

optIn.deployInstaller: deploy/install.sh refuses to render a unit that grants this path

deniedTools.loggedAs: refused_lockdownDenied / refused_secretRequired on stderr, one JSON line per refusal

policy.enforcedBy: @popopx/node-bridge assertSendable, called before the bridge is constructed
policy.unknownActionHandling: refused locally, with the canonical action list; never forwarded to the node

serialisation.reason: The node owns one actor for all ten engines, so a second queue here would only add a place for commands to be reordered.

logging.tokenRedaction: client.tokenFingerprint only; the token itself is scrubbed from every field
